input.body:
label: bug
file: src/export/csv.ts

The issue that transactions with the same date, amount and description but different currencies get merged in the CSV export likely originates from the CSV writing logic in src/export/csv.ts. Since the report fetching and exporting in src/api/reports.ts calls writeCsv(rows) directly without accounting for currency differences explicitly in row uniqueness, it points to the CSV writer as merging rows erroneously. The next step should be to inspect the CSV export implementation in src/export/csv.ts to understand how rows are processed and determine why distinct currency transactions are collapsing into single CSV lines.
